change: Margin rating = opponent-adjusted last 17 games with the prior season at 0.6 weight, plus 1.6 home field and rest; a spread or total pick needs a 3-point disagreement
Walk-forward projection per market: base rate shrunk to the slot mean, times matchup, scheme, game environment and role multipliers; fitted only on games before the week being predicted
evidence: skill vs form-only per market below

change: Calibration pass: projections scaled so mean projection equals mean actual, removing the shrinkage bias that made every over look cheap
Positions are frozen the first time a week is built and graded later against that exact line - no retroactive line shopping
TD lambda from rush + receiving touchdown rate times matchup, converted with 1 - exp(-lambda) and calibrated against the Kalshi mid
Slot assignment switched from cumulative season usage to usage RATE per game played, shrunk toward last season - a starter who missed games no longer falls behind his backup
evidence: 213 of 1263 2026 rows re-slotted; every DvP and prop number downstream changed

change: Fair probability is now leave-one-out: the price being judged is excluded from the consensus that judges it
evidence: edges at a single book no longer vouch for themselves
